item.title: Hikers follow blood trail, help rescue woman injured in bad fall
item.description: Jacque Tietjen's family says despite her extensive hiking experience, she was seriously injured during a hike at Bridal Veil Falls Tuesday.

item.title: Utah Jazz Take Jock Landale, Atlanta Hawks To Final Horn On Road
item.description: The Utah Jazz took the Atlanta Hawks to the final buzzer but ultimately fell just short in the team's first game since the NBA trade deadline.

item.title: Family says 92-year-old’s wallet stolen from Utah hospital
item.description: A family said someone took $1,000 from a 92-year-old loved one’s account and they believed the matter stemmed from the theft of a wallet at a Utah hospital.

item.title: Former Jazz Players Are Reminders Of The Pains Of Tanking
item.description: Jock Landale and Nickeil Alexander-Walker helped the Utah Jazz achieve their goal against the Hawks, but served as a reminder of three difficult years.

item.title: Door knocking pranks leading to violence, criminal charges in Utah, KSL Investigation finds
item.description: What was once considered a harmless childhood prank seems to be getting more dangerous. The KSL Investigators explore why ding-dong ditching is escalating into violent encounters.

item.title: Team USA Finalizes 2026 World Baseball Classic Roster
item.description: Team USA has unveiled its roster for the 2026 World Baseball Classic, featuring elite pitching and superstar talent as the Americans seek redemption.

item.title: New bill would let Utah teens drive at a younger age
item.description: A new bill would let Utah teens start driving with a learner’s permit at age 14 ½, and they could get their license one year later at 15 ½.

item.title: Bobby Wagner Named Walter Payton Man Of The Year
item.description: Former Utah State linebacker Bobby Wagner was named the NFL Walter Payton Man of the Year at NFL Honors on Thursday.

item.title: Utah bill to limit number of bills fails to gain traction
item.description: Okerlund's bill seeks to limit the number of bills lawmakers can request. Under his plan, senators could have ten requests, while representatives would be limited to six, with some exceptions.
